summary: Narrow tree-covered lane above the river; no stopping signs, no room to pull off.
reasons: Narrow lane, trees to creek edge

drivers.seclusion: Bush and river on the south side, but homes 23-39 m up the bank to the north.
drivers.access_and_room: Single narrow lane with trees and a steep bank on both sides; no clear ground beside it to pull fully off.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time signs on this kerb; no parked cars seen.

flags: Flood-prone: elevation 4-7 m, 16 m from Witton Creek
Steep: 7% mean, spikes at the dips
sun_shade: Dense canopy over almost the whole length.
